annotations.text:
Soft Circadian, 24-hour clock throughout. Deep indigo ground, dawn-warm accent, rounded surfaces.
Palette: bg #12142A · card #1A1D3C · text #EDEBFF · secondary #A9A6D8 · muted #8D8AC4 · accent #FFB37A. Type: Outfit 300-600.
Heatmap uses a single-hue ramp from the accent, checked so a darker cell always means a shorter fast.
